evidence: procedure_detector.py owns bounded trace selection, structured sequence validation, exact clustering, conformance gates, variability classification, and immutable reports.
dimensions.recommendation: Keep procedure promotion, memory writes, skill generation, and execution outside this detector.

evidence: The detector reads the existing experience_traces contract and depends only on SQLite, secret validation, and Safe Mode.
dimensions.recommendation: Add a versioned trace adapter if another history source becomes sufficiently structured.

evidence: A closed request fixes scope, task classes, cutoff, repetition, distinct-task, non-success, significance, and trace-count gates.
dimensions.recommendation: Do not add free-form clustering or model instructions to the request.

evidence: Experience traces remain authoritative history; migration 65 owns immutable derived detection runs and suggestions only.
dimensions.recommendation: Preserve trace lineage and never rewrite source histories from detector output.

evidence: Focused tests cover thresholds, distinct tasks, significance, adverse outcomes, exact clusters, malformed and ambiguous metadata, variability, privacy, idempotence, immutability, Safe Mode, CLI, and migration rollback.
dimensions.recommendation: Add a versioned benchmark before introducing approximate sequence matching.

evidence: Exact operation skeletons intentionally miss procedures with optional or aliased steps, while caller-authored success labels and task IDs are not independently verified.
impact_path: A producer records misleading outcomes or structurally different aliases.
The detector either misses a valid cluster or suggests a repeated but unverified skeleton.
A later consumer could over-trust the suggestion.
dimensions.recommendation: Keep output suggestion-only and require independent execution receipts and benchmarks before any promotion.

evidence: No model, embedding provider, hosted process-mining service, or network API is used.
dimensions.recommendation: Keep learned similarity behind a separately benchmarked optional adapter.

evidence: Versioned operation_sequence_v1 inputs and immutable candidate records isolate the exact-cluster algorithm from future detectors.
dimensions.recommendation: Version candidate semantics before replacing exact clustering.

abstractions.purpose: Convert repeated structured trace evidence into authority-free procedure suggestions.
use_evidence: Used by AdaptiveRuntime and procedures detect/report CLI commands.
complexity_cost: One detector, three result value types, two immutable tables, and migration 65.
abstractions.recommendation: Retain as the sole owner of procedure detection reports.
